summary.text: Jonathan Lindsey is a Republican state senator from Michigan State Senate District 17 who has served since January 1, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An Army veteran and Yale graduate, he was born in Sturgis, Michigan.

paragraphs.text: Jonathan Lindsey was born in Sturgis, Michigan, and graduated from Bronson High School.
He earned a B.A. in political science from Yale University in 2007 and served in the U.S. Army from 2009 to 2016.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Lindsey described himself as an Army Special Forces veteran and former private business executive who was born in the district and grew up on a farm there.

In the Senate, Lindsey's 2025 and 2026 assignments are the Economic and Small Business Development, Veterans and Emergency Services, and Oversight committees, and he is minority vice chair of the Housing and Human Services Committee.
In his 2022 survey, he listed the state economy and election security among his key messages.
